description: If a finitely satisfiable propositional theory \(\Gamma\) uses only atoms from a finite set \(F\), some assignment \(F\to\{0,1\}\) satisfies all of \(\Gamma\). This includes \(F=\varnothing\).
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.finite_atom_stock.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α] (F : Finset α)
  (Γ : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.Theory α)
  (hfin : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.FiniteSatisfiable Γ)
  (hsupport : ∀ A ∈ Γ, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.atoms A ⊆ F) :
  ∃ r, Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropositionalCompactness.ModelsTheory (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.extendRow F r) Γ
